The 13 recurrent states decompose under S3 into quotient 7 plus 2 copies of dimension 3; exact symbolic determinants P and Q give generating function for all n. Independent exhaustive physical configurations for n=3..6 and formal integer determinant identities reproduce critical steps; finite checks are not substitutes for proof.
